record: Indonesian Ministry of Religious Affairs building register
facts: The mosque on Jalan Menara in Kauman is registered as Al-Aqsho Menara Kudus at 110.832835 east, 6.804199 south.

record: Indonesian National Archaeology 1977 excavation report, section II A
facts: The mosque acquired its domed front porch during the 1933 works. The survey records excavation between the north foot of the minaret and the south side of the front porch.

record: Moh Rosyid's on-site study of the protected complex, 2018
facts: The brick minaret is approximately 18 metres tall and occupies a square base approximately 10 metres wide. The front and inner split gates are distinct features. One gate is recorded as 5.48 metres wide and 6.25 metres high.

record: Totok Roesmanto's architectural study of the Menara Kudus minaret
facts: The minaret sits at the southeast of the complex. It has blind niches on the north, east and south walls, and a door on the west.
